title: Review Use and Transfer of Untapped Edusave Account Monies
what_it_is: Review Use and Transfer of Untapped Edusave Account Monies

sections.label: Edusave Account and financial assistance
sections.summary: Edusave funds pay for enrichment and extra fees, unutilised monies go to the Post-Secondary Education Account, and MOE financial schemes waive school fees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Azmoon Ahmad
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Education (a) whether the Edusave Account can be used to pay for school fees where the student's family income is below the poverty threshold; and (b) whether the unutilised amount in the Edusave Account can be transferred to the individual's SkillsFuture fund after finishing school.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Hence, the funds in the Account can be used by Singaporean students aged seven to 16 to pay for enrichment programmes organised by the Ministry of Education (MOE)-funded schools, or to defray any additional fees beyond school fees and standard miscellaneous fees.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Unutilised monies in the Edusave Account will be transferred to the Post-Secondary Education Account in the year the child turns 17 years old or is no longer studying in an MOE-funded school, whichever happens later.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The monies can be tapped on to defray the cost of post-secondary education or approved SkillsFuture courses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: To help students from low-income families with schooling expenses, we have the MOE Financial Assistance Scheme (FAS).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Under the scheme, school fees and standard miscellaneous fees in Government and Government-aided Schools will be waived.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For primary and secondary students, the scheme provides for free textbooks and uniforms, and subsidised transport and school meals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For pre-university students, an annual bursary is provided.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Similar assistance is extended to students from low-income families under the Independent School Bursary scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Therefore, there has not been a need for students to tap on Edusave monies to pay their school fees and standard miscellaneous fees.
